history.summary: A 1,066 sqft freehold 'large-format' unit (listed 4BR) at Seraya Serenity, a tiny new freehold boutique in D15 Seraya Lane (TOP ~2030) at $2.77M ($2,600 PSF). The PSF is far above what nearby Seraya-Lane boutiques actually transact at (~$1,650-1,900), and it sits 1.1km from MRT — an overpriced micro-development.
history.rating_rationale: $2,600 PSF is a steep new-launch premium: comparable Seraya Lane boutiques (e.g. Seraya Residences, 2022) transact around $1,650-1,900 PSF, so the buyer pays a large markup for newness in a development likely under ~20 units. The $2.77M price exceeds the deep-liquidity band, MRT is 1.1km (13-min walk) away, and the score_1000 is the lowest in the batch (335). Tiny freehold boutiques are illiquid on exit, and there's no transaction history to anchor value. Overpriced + illiquid = Avoid.
red_flags: $2,600 PSF is far above area resale (~$1,650-1,900 PSF) — heavy new-launch premium
Micro boutique development — very shallow resale liquidity
$2.77M above the deepest-demand price band; lowest score_1000 (335) in batch
